1.pickthall: When the heaven is cleft asunder,
1.yusuf_ali: When the Sky is cleft asunder;
1.shakir: When the heaven becomes cleft asunder,
1.muhammad_sarwar: When the heavens are rent asunder,
1.mohsin_khan: When the heaven is cleft asunder.

2.sahih_international: And when the stars fall, scattering,
2.shakir: And when the stars become dispersed,
2.mohsin_khan: And when the stars have fallen and scattered;

3.sahih_international: And when the seas are erupted
3.pickthall: When the seas are poured forth,
3.yusuf_ali: When the Oceans are suffered to burst forth;
3.shakir: And when the seas are made to flow forth,
3.mohsin_khan: And when the seas are burst forth (got dried up);

4.sahih_international: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered,
4.yusuf_ali: And when the Graves are turned upside down;-
4.shakir: And when the graves are laid open,
4.muhammad_sarwar: and the graves are turned inside out,
4.mohsin_khan: And when the graves are turned upside down (and they bring out their contents)

5.sahih_international: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.
5.pickthall: A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind.
5.yusuf_ali: (Then) shall each soul know what it hath sent forward and (what it hath) kept back.
5.shakir: Every soul shall know what it has sent before and held back.
5.muhammad_sarwar: every soul will see the result of its deeds - those recorded before his death and those which will produce either virtue or evil after his death.
5.mohsin_khan: (Then) a person will know what he has sent forward and (what he has) left behind (of good or bad deeds).
5.arberry: then a soul shall know its works, the former and the latter.

6.sahih_international: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
6.pickthall: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful,
6.yusuf_ali: O man! What has seduced thee from thy Lord Most Beneficent?-
6.shakir: O man! what has beguiled you from your Lord, the Gracious one,
6.muhammad_sarwar: Human being, what evil has deceived you about your Gracious Lord,
6.mohsin_khan: O man! What has made you careless concerning your Lord, the Most Generous?
6.arberry: O Man! What deceived thee as to thy generous Lord

7.sahih_international: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?
7.pickthall: Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee?
7.yusuf_ali: Him Who created thee. Fashioned thee in due proportion, and gave thee a just bias;
7.shakir: Who created you, then made you complete, then made you symmetrical?
7.muhammad_sarwar: Who created you proportionately and fashioned you
7.mohsin_khan: Who created you, fashioned you perfectly, and gave you due proportion;
7.arberry: who created thee and shaped thee and wrought thee in symmetry

8.sahih_international: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.
8.pickthall: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee.
8.yusuf_ali: In whatever Form He wills, does He put thee together.
8.shakir: Into whatever form He pleased He constituted you.
8.mohsin_khan: In whatever form He willed, He put you together.
8.arberry: and composed thee after what form He would?

9.sahih_international: No! But you deny the Recompense.
9.pickthall: Nay, but ye deny the Judgment.
9.yusuf_ali: Nay! But ye do reject Right and Judgment!
9.shakir: Nay! but you give the lie to the judgment day,
9.muhammad_sarwar: Despite this, you deny the Day of Judgment,
9.mohsin_khan: Nay! But you deny the Recompense (reward for good deeds and punishment for evil deeds).
9.arberry: No indeed; but you cry lies to the Doom;

10.sahih_international: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,
10.pickthall: Lo! there are above you guardians,
10.yusuf_ali: But verily over you (are appointed angels) to protect you,-
10.shakir: And most surely there are keepers over you
10.muhammad_sarwar: but you should know that there are angelic guards
10.mohsin_khan: But verily, over you (are appointed angels in charge of mankind) to watch you.
10.arberry: yet there are over you watchers

11.yusuf_ali: Kind and honourable,- Writing down (your deeds):

12.yusuf_ali: They know (and understand) all that ye do.
12.muhammad_sarwar: and these honorable scribes know whatever you do.
12.mohsin_khan: They know all that you do.

13.sahih_international: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
13.pickthall: Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight.
13.yusuf_ali: As for the Righteous, they will be in bliss;
13.shakir: Most surely the righteous are in bliss,
13.muhammad_sarwar: The virtuous ones will live in bliss
13.mohsin_khan: Verily, the Abrar (pious and righteous) will be in delight (Paradise);
13.arberry: Surely the pious shall be in bliss,

14.sahih_international: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
14.pickthall: And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell;
14.yusuf_ali: And the Wicked - they will be in the Fire,
14.shakir: And most surely the wicked are in burning fire,
14.muhammad_sarwar: and the evil-doers will be in hell
14.mohsin_khan: And verily, the Fujjar (the wicked, disbelievers, sinners and evil-doers) will be in the blazing Fire (Hell),
14.arberry: and the libertines shall be in a fiery furnace

15.sahih_international: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
15.pickthall: They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment,
15.yusuf_ali: Which they will enter on the Day of Judgment,
15.shakir: They shall enter it on the day of judgment.
15.muhammad_sarwar: which they will enter on the Day of Judgment
15.mohsin_khan: In which they will enter, and taste its burning flame on the Day of Recompense,
15.arberry: roasting therein on the Day of Doom,

16.sahih_international: And never therefrom will they be absent.
16.pickthall: And will not be absent thence.
16.yusuf_ali: And they will not be able to keep away therefrom.
16.shakir: And they shall by no means be absent from it.
16.mohsin_khan: And they (Al-Fujjar) will not be absent therefrom (i.e. will not go out from the Hell).
16.arberry: nor shall they ever be absent from it.

17.sahih_international: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
17.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
17.yusuf_ali: And what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?
17.shakir: And what will make you realize what the day of judgment is?
17.muhammad_sarwar: They will never be able to escape from it. Would that you knew what the Day of Judgment is!
17.mohsin_khan: And what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is?
17.arberry: And what shall teach thee what is the Day of Doom?

18.sahih_international: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
18.pickthall: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
18.yusuf_ali: Again, what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?
18.shakir: Again, what will make you realize what the day of judgment is?
18.muhammad_sarwar: Again would that you only knew how terrible it really is!
18.mohsin_khan: Again, what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is?
18.arberry: Again, what shall teach thee what is the Day of Doom?

19.sahih_international: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.
19.pickthall: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's.
19.yusuf_ali: (It will be) the Day when no soul shall have power (to do) aught for another: For the command, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allah.
19.shakir: The day on which no soul shall control anything for (another) soul; and the command on that day shall be entirely Allah's.
19.muhammad_sarwar: On that day, no soul will be of any benefit to any other soul. On that day, all affairs will be in the hands of God.
19.mohsin_khan: (It will be) the Day when no person shall have power (to do) anything for another, and the Decision, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allah.
19.arberry: A day when no soul shall possess aught to succour another soul; that day the Command shall belong unto God.
